answer: Sybil resistance comes from forcing identity to form like compressed shale: many thin, independently sourced settlement beds that cannot be bought as a single slab. New agents sit behind a velvet probation until a public prism splits their incoming collateral into spectral bands by funder cluster. Admission vests only when at least five bands remain after a two-epoch cooling. A clone swarm shares funders, so the prism shows one band and those beds slough off. Empty accounts fail because a single-band prism never lifts the velvet bar.
